description: The grouped bar chart illustrates the task count across various linguistic categories, indicating which model performed better or if the performance was the same. The horizontal axis displays the linguistic categories arranged alphabetically: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis represents the "task count" on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40, with numeric tick labels at intervals of 10 and corresponding horizontal grid lines. For each category on the horizontal axis, up to three bars are grouped together side-by-side, each outlined in black. A legend in the top right corner, titled "better," defines the color coding for the groups: mBERT in light blue, XLM-R in dark blue, and "same" in light green. Across the categories, the XLM-R bar for IE-Slavic is the tallest overall, reaching a task count of approximately 39. The "same" category reaches its maximum in IE-Romance with a value of 30, while the mBERT category peaks in IE-Slavic at 12. Conversely, the shortest bars include mBERT in the IE-Baltic and Semitic categories, where no bars are visible (indicating a value of 0), and the "same" category in Isolate and Semitic, both at approximately 1. Other representative values include IE-Germanic with 4 for mBERT, 18 for XLM-R, and 22 for same, as well as Uralic with 1 for mBERT, 14 for XLM-R, and 5 for same.
caption_used: The bar chart compares task counts across linguistic categories for mBERT and XLM-R models, alongside tasks where performance was the same. The horizontal axis lists categories: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis represents task count, ranging from 0 to 40. In the IE-Baltic category, XLM-R consistently outperforms mBERT, with task counts exceeding 15. IE-Germanic shows a notable decline in mBERT performance, with task counts below 5, while XLM-R and 'same' are roughly equal at around 20. IE-Slavic demonstrates the highest task count for XLM-R, surpassing 45, while mBERT remains stable at approximately 10 tasks. The Isolate category exhibits minimal variation, with all models performing similarly at around 5 tasks. The legend, located in the top right, clarifies the color coding for mBERT (light blue), XLM-R (dark blue), and 'same' (light green).
